zh-Hans.promotionalText: 随时，给自己一休。在“静心”里选择 15 分钟午休、夜醒聆听或 1 分钟呼吸。27 个声音免费，支持定时、后台播放与场景海报分享。无需账号，没有广告。
zh-Hans.description:
随时，给自己一休。
不必等到有空，才可以休息。

一休冥想，是日常的休息与声音陪伴。午休、夜里醒来、工作间隙，用自然声音、古典音乐与轻柔原创，给自己一小段安静。无需注册，没有广告，也没有连续打卡的压力。

【这一刻，你想怎样休息？】
在“静心”中选择 15 分钟午休、夜里醒来时的 15 分钟轻声陪伴，或工作间隙的 1 分钟呼吸。这三个入口都可免费使用。可以跟着呼吸，也可以只听声音，随时停下。首页继续保留简洁的沉浸播放器。

【54 个声音，27 个免费】
14 种自然声：海浪、屋檐雨、溪流、鸟鸣、湖岸、微风、竹林细雨与更多自然环境音。其中 10 种免费聆听。
20 首古典名曲：德彪西《月光》、萨蒂《第一号吉姆诺佩蒂》、帕赫贝尔《D 大调卡农》、贝多芬《月光奏鸣曲》第一乐章，以及肖邦、巴赫、舒曼、莫扎特等作品。其中 10 首免费。
10 首 AI 原创音乐：「十段安静」系列，月泊、雨灯、蓝眠、雪絮、暖枕等轻柔曲目，搭配明亮自然画面。由一休创作、AI 辅助生成，5 首免费、5 首 Plus。
另有 10 首冥想与氛围音乐，绿洲停歇与初息免费。60 分钟「午后留白」延长版基于 HoliznaCC0 原曲制作。声音来源与授权可在 App 中查看。

【找到当下想听的声音】
声音库把休息用途与声音类型分开筛选，可配合搜索、免费、收藏与最近听过，一起找到合适的声音。首页左右滑动优先浏览免费场景。“我的”优先展示继续聆听、最近听过与收藏；休息记录放在设置之后，没有需要完成的目标。

【保留自己的节奏】
免费使用 5、15、30 分钟定时和一分钟呼吸静心。背景、声音与当前场景保持一致。开启后台播放后，离开 App 或锁屏也能继续聆听。
Plus 解锁完整声音库、60 分钟与不限时聆听，以及 3、5、10 分钟静心。支持恢复购买。已在 1.2 或更早版本拥有一休的用户，经验证后保留原有 14 种自然声权限。

【把安静分享出去】
将当前场景生成带二维码的图片海报，通过系统分享发送给朋友；中英文可切换。支持 iPhone 与 iPad。

【尊重你的隐私】
偏好与练习记录保存在本机。使用统计默认关闭，你可在“我的”自愿开启或随时关闭；练习手记不上传，不用于广告追踪。

订阅通过 Apple 自动续期，价格与适用优惠以购买界面为准。可在系统设置中管理或取消订阅。
隐私政策：https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/privacy.html
使用条款（Apple 标准 EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

en-US.promotionalText: Make room for quiet. Take a 15-minute lunch break, listen when awake at night, or breathe for one minute. 27 sounds free. No account. No ads.
en-US.description:
Make room for quiet.
You do not have to wait for free time to rest.

Yixiu is your everyday rest and sound companion. Take a lunch break, rest when you wake at night, or pause between tasks with nature sounds, classical music and gentle originals. No account, no ads and no streaks to maintain.

A LITTLE TIME FOR YOU
In Focus, choose a 15-minute lunch break, 15 minutes of quiet listening when awake at night, or one minute of breathing between tasks. All three are free. Follow your breath or just listen, and stop whenever you like. The home screen stays a simple, immersive player.

54 SOUNDS. 27 FREE TO ENJOY.
• 14 nature sounds: waves, rain on eaves, flowing streams, birds, a misty lake, wind and more. Ten are free.
• 20 classical works: Debussy's Clair de lune, Satie's Gymnopedie No. 1, Pachelbel's Canon in D, Beethoven's Moonlight Sonata first movement, and selections by Chopin, Bach, Schumann and Mozart. Ten are free.
• 10 AI-assisted originals: the Ten Quiet Moments collection pairs Moon Anchorage, Rain at the Window, Blue Quiet and more with bright nature artwork. Created for Yixiu with AI assistance; five free and five for Plus.
• 10 other meditation and ambient tracks, including free Oasis Rest and First Breath. The 60-minute Quiet Hour is an extended arrangement of a HoliznaCC0 recording. Recording credits are available in the app.

FIND YOUR SOUND
Filter by rest purpose and sound type separately, together with search, Free, Favorites and Recent. Swipe through free-first scenes on the home screen. Me puts continued listening, recent sounds and favorites first. Rest history sits below settings, with no goals to meet.

KEEP YOUR OWN RHYTHM
Free 5, 15 and 30-minute listening timers, plus a one-minute breathing practice. Your sound and background follow the selected scene. Enable background playback to keep listening while using another app or with your screen locked.
Plus unlocks the complete sound library, 60-minute and unlimited listening, and 3, 5 and 10-minute breathing sessions. Restore Purchases is supported. Verified owners of version 1.2 or earlier retain access to the original 14 nature sounds.

SHARE A QUIET MOMENT
Create a scene poster with a QR code and send it through the system share sheet. Switch between Chinese and English. Made for iPhone and iPad.

YOUR PRIVACY, YOUR CHOICE
Preferences and practice history stay on this device. Optional usage analytics is off by default and can be enabled or withdrawn under Me. Journal notes are not uploaded, and data is not used for advertising tracking.

Subscriptions renew automatically through Apple. Prices and eligible offers are shown before purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in system Settings.
Privacy: https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/privacy.html
Terms (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
en-US.whatsNew:
Make room for quiet.
Focus adds three free ways to pause: a 15-minute lunch break, 15 minutes of listening when awake at night, and one minute of breathing between tasks. The home screen stays uncluttered.
Follow your breath or just listen, with your sound preference preserved.
Filter the Sound Library by rest purpose and sound type, alongside search, Free, Favorites and Recent.
Me puts continued listening and favorites first. Rest history sits below settings, and other projects have their own page with Back.
Refined brand copy, current Plus benefits and bilingual navigation. Existing free content, subscriptions and privacy choices remain.

reviewNotes:
Version 1.21 (36). No login required. This update reorganizes existing free rest features in Focus only: lunch listening for 15 minutes with the free Morning Lake scene, night-waking listening for 15 minutes with free Window Rain, and a one-minute breathing break. Follow your breath and Just listen are separate modes, preserving the selected sound preference. The Sounds home remains an immersive player without scenario buttons.
Sound Library purpose and sound-type filters intersect with All/Free/Favorites/Recent and title/composer search. Me prioritizes continued listening, recent sounds and favorites; local rest history sits below settings, with no goals to meet. Related works have a separate page and Back. Future unimplemented capabilities are not listed as current Plus benefits.
Catalog, recording credits, verified access rules and subscription products are unchanged: 54 sounds, 27 Free. The Release build has no DEBUG or YIXIU_INTERNAL_PLUS flags or forced-membership entitlement. StoreKit verifies membership and restores purchases.
Usage analytics is optional, off by default and withdrawable under Me. Meaningful-rest statistics use actual playback progress or completed breathing, not configured timer duration, and respect consent. Local journal records and text are not uploaded. No IDFA/IDFV or precise location is collected, and no advertising tracking is used.
